dedupe_keys.name: points de reperes des routes departementales de la haute garonne bornage

description: Points de repères des routes départementales de la Haute-Garonne : bornage is a dataset listed in Open Data Haute-Garonne, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil départemental de la Haute-Garonne. Le repérage (bornage) est indispensable pour localiser sans ambiguïté des informations le long des routes. Bornage: le bornage est un ensemble de points positionnés sur les routes départementales de la Haute-Garonne. Coverage: Haute-Garonne. The portal files it under Déplacements. Its keywords are Routes départementales, Voirie, Infrastructures routières, Mobilité, Circulation. The portal shows 7,360 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-haute-garonne-fr-portal.
